project_name.justification: The press release announces an option agreement for Torr Metals Inc. to "acquire 100% of the 57 km² Bertha Property (“Bertha”)."

company_name.justification: The acquiring company is identified as "Torr Metals Inc. (“Torr” or the “Company”) (TSX-V: TMET.V)".

ceo_buyer.justification: The press release is signed off by "Malcolm Dorsey President, CEO and Director".

interest_acquired_percent.justification: Torr has entered into a property option agreement (the “Bertha Property Option Agreement”) to acquire a 100% interest in a series of mineral claims located in the province of British Columbia referred to as the “Bertha Property”

primary_commodity.justification: The headline of the article is "Torr Metals Expands Kolos Project with Optioning of Drill-Permitted Bertha Property, Featuring Historical High-Grade Copper Up to 8.48% in Outcrop". The text also states "The Bertha Property hosts nine significant copper and gold occurrences".

verified_article_link.justification: No article link was provided in the source documents.

currency.justification: The net smelter return buydown clause specifies the currency: "a cash payment of $1,000,000 (CDN)."

cash_payments_raw.justification: The total cash payment is the sum of all tranches mentioned in the agreement: $5,000 upon signing, $20,000 within three months, $25,000 on the 1st anniversary, $75,000 on the 2nd anniversary, and $125,000 on the 3rd anniversary.

share_payments_raw.justification: No explicit dollar value for the share payments is provided. The deal is structured with a number of shares to be issued, which is captured in other fields.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: The cash and share components of the deal are listed separately and not as a single combined value.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: The total shares to be issued is the sum of all tranches specified in the agreement: "issue 100,000 common shares", "issue 200,000 common shares", "issue 200,000 common shares", and "issue 400,000 common shares".

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: The transaction terms do not mention any share warrants.

option_payments_raw.justification: The transaction terms do not mention any option payments.

issued_share_price.justification: The transaction terms mention the number of shares issued, but not the price. Using the last traded price as a fallback, as seen in the detailed quote: 'Last: 0.14'.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: The exploration commitment is specified as a monetary value, not in meters of drilling.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: The agreement requires Torr to "On the 3rd anniversary of the approval date... complete a minimum of $500,000 of expenditures on the Bertha Property".

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: The property is acquired "subject to a 2% net smelter return."

coverage_area_raw.justification: The agreement is to "acquire 100% of the 57 km² Bertha Property (“Bertha”)."

coverage_area_unit.justification: The agreement is to "acquire 100% of the 57 km² Bertha Property (“Bertha”)."

resource_size.justification: The article mentions historical drill and trench results but does not contain a quantified mineral resource estimate with total tonnage or ounces.

buyer_ticker_and_exchange.justification: The buyer is identified as "Torr Metals Inc. (“Torr” or the “Company”) (TSX-V: TMET.V)" and the detailed quote section confirms "Exchange: TSXV".
